entities.name: Azcanta
entities.description: Ruined, partially sunken ancient city of Ixalan said to hold forgotten knowledge.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Native merfolk who fiercely protected their waterways and destroyed Azcanta's power.

entities.name: Inner Sea
entities.description: Sea in which Azcanta's ruins lie.

events.summary: After years of war the River Heralds unleash ancient magic that destroys Azcanta and drags it beneath the waves.
events.quote: the merfolk of the River Heralds unleashed potent and ancient magic to break Azcanta’s power once and for all

relations.quote: locked in constant and bitter conflict with the native River Heralds
